name: pull-to-refresh
title: PullToRefresh
description: Mobile-only refresh-on-pull gesture wrapper. Detects a downward drag at the top of a scroll container, expands a Spinner-bearing reveal area, and fires onRefresh when the user pulls past the threshold. Auto-collapses when the consumer resolves the refresh. Distinct from button-driven refresh (use a Refresh IconButton in the Toolbar).
